name: Halfling

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: Fortune +5 points (0.5% × Luck + 5%, still capped at 25%); one free re-roll of a failed Trap Disarm per floor (the failure does not trigger the trap).

traits.name: Small
traits.description: +5 points of Dodge after the 30% cap (effective cap 35%); Large monsters have −10 Accuracy against you with single-target melee, Huge ones −15.

traits.name: Nimble Fingers
traits.description: Lockpicking counts two ranks higher and Haggling one (both may exceed 10).

traits.name: Light Frame
traits.description: Carry capacity ×0.70; heavy two-handers (weight 1,400: greatswords, mauls, two-handed axes, crossbows) need +2 Strength over the listed requirement (bows and staves exempt); max HP ×0.90; tower shields are locked.

restrictions.reason: Taller than you are; bucklers are fine.

creationBlurb: Barge-folk salvagers. Lucky, small, and no lock has met them.
